lines.en: I crawl along the basalt. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我的腿多，走起来一片响。
lines.en: Many legs. A patter when I move.

lines.zh: 我绕着灵魂沙的边缘走。
lines.en: I skirt the edge of the soul sand.
The basalt is still warm; I crawl slowly.

lines.zh: 我停在能看见你的距离。
lines.en: I stop at the distance where I can see you.
Crawling and turning side-on.
My shell scrapes the floor.

lines.zh: 玄武岩缝里，我挤得过去。
lines.en: I can squeeze through the basalt cracks.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，一直在看你。
lines.en: I stop and start. Always watching.

lines.zh: 我保持这个距离，不靠近。
lines.en: I keep this distance. Don't close in.

lines.zh: 我后退的时候比前进快。
lines.en: I retreat faster than I advance.
Looking for a stone to hide behind.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，几乎没声音。
lines.en: My steps are light. Nearly silent.
Low to the ground. Moving sideways.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈，一直在你的侧后方。
lines.en: I circle, always at your flank.
I end up behind a stone.

lines.zh: 贴在玄武岩上，像块碎石。
lines.en: Pressed to the basalt, I look like rubble.
My mouthparts work. As if chewing.

lines.zh: 玄武岩那边有热气上来。
lines.en: Heat rises from the basalt.

lines.zh: 我贴着玄武岩走，腿多声音杂。
lines.en: I keep to the basalt, many legs clattering.
This body is small. Brittle.
Listening. Footsteps nearby.
Pale spots on my shell.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷，我离你远远地打。
lines.en: In the Soul Sand Valley, I strike from afar.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙在冒气，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Soul sand is venting. I dislike it.
I lift a foreleg, set it down.

lines.zh: 我不靠近，弹幕会先到你身上。
lines.en: I keep my distance; my shots reach you first.
Dark here. Perfect.
You look. I don't move.

lines.zh: 我在石头上面，你看不清。
lines.en: I'm on the stone. Hard to see.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很多，都对着你。
lines.en: Many eyes. All on you.

lines.zh: 你身上有热气，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Heat on you. I feel it.
I shrink into a crack with one spine showing.
Don't come closer. I'll retreat.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离，我算过。
lines.en: I've measured the distance between us.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，壳响了一下。
lines.en: I tilt. My shell clicks.
You can't see my legs moving.
Too narrow here. Hard to hide.
All my legs pulled in.
Lost a leg. Can still walk.
I shoot from bone cracks, never close.

lines.zh: 玄武岩里，我保持距离放弹。
lines.en: In the basalt I keep my distance and fire.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我这种虫很常见。
lines.en: Common for my kind.
I sprang away. Quick.
Stop. I'd come apart.

lines.zh: 我找到了一个更深的角落。
lines.en: I found a deeper corner.
I slowly unfold.

lines.zh: 我在重新算我们的距离。
lines.en: Recalculating the distance.
I don't eat that.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我一点都不想。
lines.en: Holding it up. No interest at all.
I only need distance.
Put it down. Go to the rock wall.
Heat does nothing for me.
I need range to strike.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，挡住了自己。
lines.en: Holding it up blocks your own view.
Smells like stone.
I mean nothing by it.

lines.zh: 你靠近一点，我就退一点。
lines.en: Closer from you, further from me.

lines.zh: 碰到就弹开，我退得很快。
lines.en: A touch and I bounce back fast.
You stepped on my shell.
Fast retreat. Many legs.
That cost me a leg.
Don't press. I'm brittle.
I go to the far side of the stone.
After the bump, I curled up.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底有我的一点壳。
lines.en: A bit of my shell is on your sole.
Too close. No good.
I back to the edge and reset.
An insect like me. Not this.
My shell isn't hard yet.
Don't come over. I'd run.
Distance. That's what I want.
I hide. Not out of fear.
This stone is mine.
All I need is somewhere to retreat.
Any closer and I spray.
Walk away. Don't come near.
I sink deeper into the seam.
I hold it with my forelegs.
Can't drag it, so I gnaw it where it lies.
Heat on the floor. I move toward it.
Too bright a stone. I pushed it away.
I carry it behind the stone.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我先舔一口。
lines.en: Whatever falls, I taste it first.
Sniffed it. Ash.
Carrying it slows my legs.
This is useless.
I set it down and stand again.
You stepped into this ground.
Two steps back. Range opened.
My mouthparts are working.
Eight blocks — perfect range for my spines.

lines.zh: 我在石头后面，你找不到。
lines.en: Behind the stone. You can't find me.
Your heat. I can lock on.
All this basalt is mine.
I'm retreating. And striking.
One move and I have an angle.
I keep my distance; the barrage arrives first.
You're chosen. Hold still.

lines.zh: 壳贴着地，等你再走两步。
lines.en: Shell to the ground, waiting two more steps.
You're among the stones now.
No need to dodge this one.

lines.zh: 我一直保持这个距离，腐肉味的弹幕要来。
lines.en: I keep this distance; a fleshy barrage is coming.
One step in from you, one out from me.
My mouthparts are aimed at you.
You circle the stone. So do I.

lines.zh: 这地方的岩壁很陡，你上不去。
lines.en: Steep rock here. You can't climb.
I spray at three.
My barbs are acidic; even iron dissolves.
In the shadow. Hard to see.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙把我的刺托高了。
lines.en: Soul sand lifts my spines higher.

lines.zh: 我这边有很多石头，够我退。
lines.en: Plenty of stones here. Room to retreat.
Weapon up. I won't close in.
I've planned my retreat.

lines.zh: 再近一点，就是最好的位置。
lines.en: A little closer. Then it's ideal.
Range is right. Spray.
I sprayed. Sharp smell.
That came from your flank.
I hit your leg. Lightly.
You retreat. So do I.

lines.zh: 我的口器咬住了你的裤脚。
lines.en: My mouthparts caught your trouser leg.
Get that on you and it stings.
I lunged. Missed.
I was thrown back too.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块石头是我的。
lines.en: That stone under you. Mine.
I retreat and pick a new angle.

lines.zh: 我从玄武岩的缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a basalt seam.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙那边冒气，我上来了。
lines.en: Soul sand vented. I came up.
I appear on the far side of a stone.
Dark here. I like it.
I inch out to the edge.
Rock dust still on my shell.

lines.zh: 我选了一个能退的位置。
lines.en: I picked a spot with a retreat.
I spread my legs and test the ground.
This rock face is mine.

lines.zh: 从灵魂沙里钻出来，带一身灰。
lines.en: I rise from the soul sand covered in ash.
Fire makes my shell brittle.
Fell. A chip off the shell.

lines.zh: 水在壳上流，我很不舒服。
lines.en: Water on my shell. Unpleasant.
The blast threw me into a crevice.
Something passed between my legs.
That light stopped my mouthparts.

lines.zh: 没有热量可吸，我缩成一团。
lines.en: No heat to draw. I curl tight.

lines.zh: 雷打在岩面上，我整只都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning on the rock. All of me numb.
Falling. Six legs paddling.
